prompt: Which reaction CANNOT proceed by a radical mechanism as drawn?

options.label: Addition of HBr to benzene to give bromobenzene (benzene needs ionic EAS; HBr doesn't do radical EAS on arenes).
Anti-Markovnikov HBr addition to propene with peroxides.

explanation: Aromatic halogenation goes by electrophilic (ionic) mechanism (Br⁺ generated by FeBr₃), not radical. The others are classic radical reactions.
